questions.q: Which is a non-renewable energy source?
questions.why: Uranium is finite, so nuclear power is non-renewable.
Desalination makes fresh water from sea water; it is costly and energy hungry.

questions.q: What is the enhanced greenhouse effect?
options: Extra warming caused by more greenhouse gases from human activity
questions.why: Human emissions add to the natural effect and raise global temperatures.

questions.q: Explain why wind power is not a perfect solution for a country's energy needs.
questions.model: Wind is intermittent, so turbines produce no electricity when the wind drops. Turbines are also costly and have a visual and noise impact.
points: other valid drawback (cost, visual impact, noise, birds)
